summaries.zh: 这期 Lex Fridman 播客（第501期）邀请到 Ruby on Rails 创始人、Omarchy Linux 开发者、37signals CTO DHH。两人围绕编程的未来展开讨论，涵盖 AI 编程代理、vibe coding 与 agentic engineering 的区别、AI 对开源的影响、手动编程的终结等话题。DHH 还谈到自己构建 Linux 发行版的经历、AI 编程模型与工具的选择、语音提示与打字对比，以及对程序员的建议。节目也涉及 Linux 桌面前景、AI 视频生成、父职、政治与移民、长寿与死亡等广泛内容。
summaries.en: In this podcast episode, David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH)—creator of Ruby on Rails and Omarchy Linux, and CTO of 37signals—discusses the future of programming and AI. Topics include AI agents in software development, vibe coding versus agentic engineering, the end of manual programming, AI's impact on open source, and best AI coding models and tools. DHH also shares advice for programmers, reflects on building Omarchy, Linux's desktop potential, AI video generation, fatherhood, politics, longevity, and existential themes like eternal recurrence. The episode includes sponsor segments and a full interview outline with timestamps.

summaries.zh: 陶哲轩被誉为历史上最伟大的数学家之一，曾获菲尔兹奖和数学突破奖。他在流体力学（纳维-斯托克斯方程）、数学物理与量子力学、素数及解析数论、调和分析、压缩感知、随机矩阵理论、组合学等领域均有重要贡献。这期播客探讨了数学与物理中的难题、现实本质、人工智能辅助定理证明、Lean编程语言、AlphaProof，以及AI未来能否赢得菲尔兹奖等话题。
summaries.en: In this podcast episode, Lex Fridman interviews Terence Tao, one of history’s greatest mathematicians and a Fields Medal and Breakthrough Prize winner. They discuss his contributions across fields like fluid dynamics, number theory, harmonic analysis, and combinatorics. Tao also explores major unsolved problems such as the Navier–Stokes singularity, the Twin Prime and Collatz conjectures, and P = NP. The conversation examines the nature of reality, the theory of everything, and the growing role of AI in mathematics—including AI-assisted theorem proving and whether AI could one day win a Fields Medal.
